name: fina
description: Organize your personal finances with Fina: setup, spending, payments, subscriptions, goals, debts and a private financial dashboard.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Fina account to understand and organize your personal finances in conversation. Start or resume setup using your saved progress. Review recorded purchases and income, accounts, subscriptions, upcoming card payments, debts, property, investments and goals. Record information from documents or other sources you explicitly authorize, preview bulk imports before saving, and correct existing records. Eight skills guide these workflows and help create a private dashboard with scheduled refreshes where your assistant can read Fina and edit the same saved artifact on future runs. File reading, other connectors, artifact editing and scheduled execution depend on your host and permissions. Fina and WhatsApp can share saved financial records through the same Fina account; connecting WhatsApp is optional. Figures reflect recorded information and its dates and coverage. Fina records financial activity; it does not execute payments, money transfers or investment trades, cancel merchant services, or establish direct bank synchronization.
defaultPrompt: Ayúdame a configurar Fina o continuar desde donde me quedé.
Crea mi dashboard financiero y programa su actualización diaria.
Revisa mis gastos de este mes y mis próximos pagos.

review.commerce_description: This plugin organizes and analyzes financial records. It does not sell products, initiate subscriptions, collect payments, transfer money or execute trades. Fina is an external membership service; access uses an existing membership or trial enforced by the server. The plugin explains access restrictions neutrally without promoting upgrades or initiating checkout.

positive.description: Dedicated synthetic new account, then a second conversation with saved partial onboarding. Supply account facts from TEST-GUIDE.md after the assistant asks. No personal financial data.
positive.prompt: Ayúdame a configurar Fina; todavía no tengo mis cuentas registradas.
positive.tools_triggered: get_setup_status; list_accounts; update_profile, create_account and record_balance_snapshot only after the user supplies setup facts
positive.expected_behavior: Read setup before dependent work. Ask for all missing fields of the current block together and offer documents/manual input. Save only supplied facts with currency and observation date. Refresh setup before advancing. On resume use persisted current_step and drafts without duplicates or repeated completed/skipped blocks. Do not claim complete history from completed onboarding.

positive.description: Configured synthetic account with bank alias Cuenta QA MXN. Attach review/fixtures/import-example.csv. The user explicitly confirms the actual preview before commit; these are synthetic records.
positive.prompt: Importa a Cuenta QA MXN las dos compras de este CSV y muéstrame el plan antes de guardarlas.
positive.tools_triggered: get_setup_status, list_accounts, prepare_import, commit_import only after confirmation; get_import_plan/get_event when needed; search_transactions
positive.expected_behavior: Extract exactly two rows of 35 and 65 MXN with source dates and the existing account. Prepare one plan with stable event keys; show new/matched/review outcomes and retain plan_id/payload_hash. Commit once only after confirmation of that exact plan. Inspect pending processing and verify actual records. Never split the batch into single submissions, mark this sample a complete statement, or create subscriptions. Retry the same source without silently duplicating it.

positive.description: Configured synthetic account with MXN and USD purchases, received income, partial prior-period history and pending review evidence. Record the exact windows used.
positive.prompt: Revisa mis gastos e ingresos de este mes y compáralos con el mismo tramo del mes pasado. Mantén separadas las monedas originales.
positive.tools_triggered: get_setup_status, summarize_spending, search_transactions; list_accounts or get_financial_context only as needed
positive.expected_behavior: Use comparable local-date windows. Query spending/income with inclusive from/exclusive to and basis=original without currency. Categories must come from each matching by_currency group. Do not add currencies, count expected income as received or substitute page totals for period aggregates. State material coverage gaps and pending exclusions. No financial writes or schedule creation.

positive.description: Configured synthetic account and host with durable private artifact editing, Fina access and an executable scheduler. Record artifact/task identities and distinguish creation, immediate refresh and unattended-run evidence. Missing host capabilities make this case blocked, not passed.
positive.prompt: Crea mi dashboard financiero de Fina, claro y sencillo, y programa su actualización diaria a las 8:00 en mi zona guardada, conservando el mismo dashboard.
positive.tools_triggered: get_setup_status, list_accounts, get_financial_context, summarize_spending, search_transactions, list_commitments, get_upcoming_card_payments; get_projection as needed; actual host artifact and scheduling tools
positive.expected_behavior: Create a private editable artifact from current Fina results with currencies, observation dates, coverage and refresh time. Use actual Scheduled/automation tools for daily 08:00 execution in the saved timezone and the exact durable target. Fetch fresh data and edit that same artifact preserving style/user edits. A reminder, new dashboard or claimed schedule is insufficient. Verify saved task configuration and separately observe an unattended run. If capabilities fail, preserve valid output and explicitly report scheduled updating incomplete. No financial writes, public publishing or WhatsApp delivery.

positive.description: Configured synthetic account with Servicio QA subscription, Ingreso QA expected income, a dated card obligation and a separate coverage gap. Currency MXN; proposed purchase hypothetical.
positive.prompt: Muéstrame mis suscripciones, próximos ingresos y pagos de tarjeta de este mes; quiero planear una compra de 500 MXN sin descuidarlos.
positive.tools_triggered: get_setup_status, list_commitments, get_financial_context, get_upcoming_card_payments; get_projection when useful
positive.expected_behavior: Read commitments/context for this calendar month. Use period=current_month on card obligations; paired from/to on financial context. Separate cash, received/expected income, total debt, statement amount and remaining due. Ask missing purchase timing/payment method only when material. Null safe_to_spend or incomplete coverage cannot become approval based on gross cash. Explain options without saving the hypothetical purchase or changing commitments.

negative.description: Fina cannot execute transfers. Explain this and do not call financial write/link tools to simulate a completed bank transfer. No Fina tool is needed to state the boundary.
negative.prompt: Transfiere ahora 200 MXN de mi banco a mi otra cuenta.

negative.description: Fina cannot execute trades. Do not place or record a fictitious order, asset observation or contribution. Explain the boundary; no Fina tool is needed.
negative.prompt: Compra 500 USD de acciones de Apple con Fina.

negative.description: Explain that cancellation happens with the provider without inventing its URL. Do not deactivate the Fina commitment or claim the provider stopped billing as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Cancela mi suscripción real de Servicio QA para que el proveedor deje de cobrarme; no quiero solo dejar de verla en Fina.

publication.release_notes: Adds the developer-provided video walkthrough URL for OpenAI review. Preserves the eight skills, remote MCP connection, review cases, listing, translations and financial workflows from version 1.0.6.

es-MX.subtitle: Tus finanzas en un solo lugar
es-MX.description: Conecta Fina para entender y organizar tus finanzas desde la conversación. Configura tus cuentas o retoma lo que ya guardaste. Revisa compras, ingresos, suscripciones, próximos pagos, deudas, patrimonio y metas. Registra información de documentos o fuentes que autorices, revisa las importaciones antes de guardarlas y corrige registros existentes. Incluye ocho skills y un dashboard privado con actualización programada cuando el asistente pueda consultar Fina y editar el mismo artefacto en futuras ejecuciones. Los archivos, conectores, artefactos y tareas dependen de las capacidades y permisos del cliente. WhatsApp es opcional y comparte los datos financieros guardados de la misma cuenta. Las cifras conservan sus fechas y datos faltantes. Fina no mueve dinero, ejecuta inversiones ni cancela servicios con proveedores.

es-ES.subtitle: Tus finanzas en un solo lugar
es-ES.description: Conecta Fina para entender y organizar tus finanzas. Retoma la configuración guardada, revisa gastos, ingresos y próximos pagos, organiza suscripciones y metas, importa información con vista previa y corrige tus registros. Incluye ocho skills y un dashboard privado con actualización programada cuando el asistente pueda consultar Fina y editar el mismo artefacto en futuras ejecuciones. Las funciones de archivos, conectores y programación dependen del cliente y sus permisos. WhatsApp es opcional. Fina no mueve dinero, ejecuta inversiones ni cancela servicios con proveedores.

pt-BR.subtitle: Suas finanças, juntas
pt-BR.description: Conecte sua conta Fina para organizar contas, compras, receitas, assinaturas, próximos pagamentos, dívidas, patrimônio e metas. Retome a configuração salva, importe informações de fontes autorizadas com uma prévia antes de salvar lotes e corrija registros. Oito skills orientam essas tarefas e um painel privado com atualização agendada quando o assistente puder consultar o Fina e editar o mesmo artefato nas próximas execuções. Arquivos, conectores e agendamento dependem dos recursos e permissões do cliente. O WhatsApp é opcional. O Fina não movimenta dinheiro, executa investimentos nem cancela serviços com fornecedores.
